name: Instruct assistants to memorize and recall specific information
description: Users asked the AI assistant to store, memorize, or acknowledge specific texts, personal details, or code snippets for future retrieval or confirmation. Many requests involved providing large amounts of information in sequential chunks with instructions to acknowledge receipt only until a stop signal was given, while others asked the assistant to recall specific details from current or previous interactions.
